statement:
by
  classical
  exact let I := fun n : ℕ => Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3); let P := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 2 z).filter Nat.Prime; let V := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/n * ∏ p ∈ (P z).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ n), (1-2/(p:ℝ)); let S := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ z < (u*(n-u)).minFac)).card; let Z₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let B := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter Even; let good := fun n u : ℕ => u.Coprime n ∧ (Z₁ n) < (u*(n-u)).minFac ∧ u.primeFactorsList.length=2 ∧ (n-u).primeFactorsList.length=2 ∧ u.minFac ≤ 2*(n-u).minFac ∧ (n-u).minFac ≤ 2*u.minFac; ∃ κ δ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ T, (((B X).filter (fun n => (((I n).filter (good n)).card:ℝ) < κ*(n:ℝ)/(Real.log (n:ℝ))^3)).card:ℝ) ≤ (X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在立方根筛后，两个半素数的最小素因子相差不超过两倍；证明多数偶目标仍有 ≫n/log³n 个这样的表示，并取得幂节省例外界。
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptional sets for reflected rough semiprimes whose least factors differ by at most a factor of two.

brief.zh: 在最小因子相对接近的细对角带中研究反射相关。因子指数带宽约为 1/log n，比固定指数矩形更薄；固定矩形的渐近式无法直接给出此结论。先对相邻倍区间做双线性估计，再求和并控制例外。
brief.en: This is a shrinking diagonal strip of exponent width O(1/log n), finer than fixed rectangles. Sum bilinear estimates on adjacent dyadic factor intervals and retain power-saving control of exceptional even targets.
